PI0277 A0 executed — release 63151a4548243ab0fb4ba172eea6f7d92e02c576 / canonical #6014658161.

Actual saved-array audit is committed at f2d453e2 on the existing branch. No new model query, optimizer update, teacher call or physics step was used.

- Reconstructed all 48 old TASK8192 episodes from saved 100 Hz arrays; independently aggregated event timestamps using the disclosed pinned native predicate math. REPAIR_DEV: 24 no sustained grasp, 8 grasp but no sustained 2 cm lift. TRAIN: 10 no sustained grasp, 5 grasp but no sustained lift, 1 original valid gate refusal. Total sustained grasps 13/48, sustained lifts 0/48, on-top occurrences 0/48. The lift criterion is diagnostic only; original task success stays unchanged. This localizes failure before successful transport/release, without proving a unique gripper cause.
- Verified command -> native gripper transport against saved actual installed actions for all 48, retaining existing declared actuator saturation and separate measured opening. Full timestamped event lists and per-control timelines are saved. Timeline time_s denotes command start; measured state columns are interval-end samples.
- Joined all 16,384 actual PI0276 consumption records against immutable schedule/input/label identities. Of each policy's original 128 TRAIN offline windows, 90 were actually consumed and 38 were same-episode unconsumed windows; VAL remains 64.
- Froze the original schedule's first 8,192 visits: 6,702 unique windows, 2,048 visits per source group. Audited all 93 TRAIN command sequences and their 186 open/close transitions; no completely identical input hash with differing label hashes was found. Near-identical visual aliasing is UNOBSERVED.
- Froze the 64 fit-panel window identities by registered event/visit rule, independent of model scores. Actual new fit noise packets still require prequery sealing.
- Source inspection confirms native loss denominator action_mask.sum()+1e-6 (400 active full-H40 elements), not 132-channel averaging. Existing generated gripper MAE is detached logging; native and possible indirect generated gradients remain acknowledged.
- The new FP32 generated-gripper loss passed zero/nonzero, analytical gradient, finite difference, mask and 8/32 temporal-weight CPU checks. Real four-step model gradient/resume evidence remains pending.
- REF_W0 / FAST_CACHE0 / FAST_CACHE2 code is implemented; actual cache admission, CPU timings and H200 speed/equivalence are NOT YET RUN. No speedup or launch readiness is claimed. Next work is the bounded allocated runtime qualification, then both 4096 arms and fixed evaluation under the original GO.

PI0276 source/prediction readback children 3348169/3455362 remain live with byte progress (2026-10-06T11:18:49Z); old archives are preserved and their final receipts remain pending. selected/deployment=NONE.
